howItWorks.heading: How RoktoSetu Works
howItWorks.subheading: A decentralized, high-speed protocol connecting seekers to voluntary donors in minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Seeker submits emergency blood request with hospital verification. Matching begins instantly.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Smart geohash rings (5km → 10km → 25km) notify verified, eligible donors without exposing contact numbers.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Donor accepts, hospital confirms transfusion, and official Certified Blood Donor milestones are awarded.

mapTeaser.heading: Live Nationwide Donor Radar
mapTeaser.subheading: Explore real-time donor availability across Bangladesh. Donor locations are protected with ~500m coordinate fuzzing.

trust.heading: Integrity & Privacy by Design
trust.subheading: Built from the ground up to protect patients and eliminate commercial blood trafficking.
trust.pillar1Desc: Blood is a voluntary gift of life. Automated word-boundary filters detect and ban all selling attempts.
trust.pillar2Desc: Donor NID and medical records are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored behind signed URLs.
trust.pillar3Desc: Fundraisers require registered doctor credentials checked against Bangladesh Medical & Dental Council.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about donating or seeking blood voluntarily on RoktoSetu.
faq.q1: Is RoktoSetu completely free to use?
faq.a1: Yes, 100% free for individual seekers and donors. No hidden fees or commercial donor payments are ever permitted.
faq.q2: How is my private contact number protected?
faq.a2: Your phone number is completely hidden. It is only revealed when you explicitly click 'Accept' on an emergency request.
faq.q3: Who is eligible to donate blood in Bangladesh?
faq.a3: Healthy individuals aged 18 to 60, weighing at least 45 kg (females) or 50 kg (males), with a minimum 90-day gap since their last donation.
faq.a4: Every campaign undergoes strict 4-eyes review: hospital admission proof, BMDC doctor verification, and double-entry ledger escrow.

ctaBand.heading: Need Blood Urgently Right Now?
ctaBand.subheading: Don't wait. Broadcast an emergency request to nearby verified donors on the live map in under 60 seconds.

footer.mission: A decentralized blood-donation network and medical treatment fundraiser. Every drop, a bridge to life.
footer.disclaimer: Medical Disclaimer: RoktoSetu is a technology platform connecting voluntary donors, seekers, and medical centers. RoktoSetu does not provide medical services, diagnosis, or transfusion facilities. All blood compatibility testing and transfusions must be conducted by certified clinical personnel.
